question.text: What is the maximum oversubscription that can be retained in a public issue of debt securities (without shelf prospectus)?

answer.text: Up to 50% of the base issue size
Up to 200% of the base issue size
Up to 100% of the base issue size

explanation.text: The Logic: In a public issue of debt securities without a shelf prospectus, oversubscription can be retained up to 100% of the base issue size. For shelf prospectus issues, retention is allowed up to the rated size. The Trap: Candidates may think no oversubscription retention is allowed (as in some equity contexts) or confuse the 100% limit with the 200% figure sometimes seen in other contexts. Cross-Exam Context: NISM Series IX tests oversubscription retention limits differently for debt vs. equity, and for shelf prospectus vs. regular prospectus.
